candidateReviews.label: Argument from ignorance
candidateReviews.context: physics cannot rule out a cause or a beginning
candidateReviews.rationale: Non-exclusion is expressly only a roadmap point conditioned on a separate sound deduction, so truth is not inferred merely from non-disproof.

candidateReviews.label: Begging the question
candidateReviews.context: this line is still either finite or infinite in extension
candidateReviews.rationale: The reply assumes the metric-extension dichotomy that the nonmetric proposal denies, building the disputed conclusion into its premise.

candidateReviews.label: Equivocation
candidateReviews.context: events are truly present in fundamental physics even in the most fundamental level
candidateReviews.rationale: The move insufficiently distinguishes emergent events from their ground, but no clear shift in one key term’s meaning is established.

candidateReviews.label: Equivocation
candidateReviews.context: that transition itself would also be a kind of events
candidateReviews.rationale: Grounding or constitution is shifted into temporal transition, treating an explanatory relation as a happening despite the explicit layered distinction.

candidateReviews.label: Equivocation
candidateReviews.context: interaction in scientific and physical research context is a causal term
candidateReviews.rationale: Reciprocal physical interaction is shifted into the asymmetric efficient causation required by the argument, although those meanings are not equivalent.

candidateReviews.label: Appeal to authority
candidateReviews.context: philosopher of physics Christopher Weaver has noted that the word interaction is a causal term
candidateReviews.rationale: The sources provide terminology rather than prestige offered as decisive proof; the defect concerns the inference from terminology, not authority alone.

candidateReviews.label: Argument from ignorance
candidateReviews.context: there’s no good reason to think that it’s not fundamentally due to design
candidateReviews.rationale: Absence of a demonstrated reason against design is treated as positive support that design is true without the required comparative evidence.

candidateReviews.label: Argument from ignorance
candidateReviews.context: causation plausibly has a physical explanation and if so physical reality as a whole couldn’t have a cause
candidateReviews.rationale: This is a conditional and defeasible emergence argument, not a declaration that the hypothesis is true because alternatives remain unproved.

candidateReviews.label: Scope neglect
candidateReviews.context: a designer is a kind of cause and therefore my theological argument is relevant
candidateReviews.rationale: The move blurs arrangement with totality, but catalog scope neglect concerns proportional magnitude or number, not this ontological scope mismatch.

candidateReviews.label: Begging the question
candidateReviews.context: there’ll be no cause that makes it the case that only X rather than Y begins uncaused
candidateReviews.rationale: The conditional presumes only a cause can differentiate outcomes, importing the universal causal requirement that the argument purports to establish.

candidateReviews.label: Special pleading
candidateReviews.context: something which begins without material cause could still have an efficient cause
candidateReviews.rationale: A principled conceptual difference is offered because an efficient selector remains available; incomplete support is not an unexplained exception.

candidateReviews.label: Begging the question
candidateReviews.context: there will be no differentiation between X and Y until these things have already begun
candidateReviews.rationale: The answer inadequately handles nomic constraints, but the critique identifies a modal disagreement and weak support rather than clear conclusion-smuggling.

candidateReviews.label: Equivocation
candidateReviews.context: if there’s no cause whatsoever then there will be nothing that makes it the case
candidateReviews.rationale: Every explanatory differentiator is treated as a cause, shifting causal production into explanatory reason and excluding the opponent’s distinction by definition.

candidateReviews.label: Begging the question
candidateReviews.context: if everyone is like this no one will ever begin to have money
candidateReviews.rationale: The analogy assumes every regress member independently lacks the resource, building the need for an external first source into the model.

candidateReviews.label: Appeal to authority
candidateReviews.context: in my book publications I’ve showed that it’s not the case
candidateReviews.rationale: Outside publications leave the exclusion underdeveloped, but no authorial prestige is treated as independently settling the regress argument.

candidateReviews.label: Begging the question
candidateReviews.context: unstable means that it will only have existed in that state for a finite amount of time
candidateReviews.rationale: The objection assumes measurable duration and manifestation conditions within the nonmetric state, precisely the structure whose availability is disputed.

candidateReviews.label: Begging the question
candidateReviews.context: it must also have the capacity to prevent itself from changing
candidateReviews.rationale: The asserted withholding capacity already supplies the alternative control needed for libertarian agency, embedding the personal-control conclusion in an unsupported premise.

candidateReviews.label: Begging the question
candidateReviews.context: in that state is holding back its disposition with freedom
candidateReviews.rationale: Absence of an event is redescribed as free withholding, presupposing the personal control the argument is meant to establish.

overallBlunderCandidateReviews.label: Appeal to authority
overallBlunderCandidateReviews.context: relied chiefly on a borrower analogy and references to outside publications
overallBlunderCandidateReviews.rationale: The references replace debate-level development, but no person or institution’s prestige is treated as independently settling the regress.

overallBlunderCandidateReviews.label: Begging the question
overallBlunderCandidateReviews.context: treated instability withholding and libertarian freedom as mutually supporting
overallBlunderCandidateReviews.rationale: Withholding is used to infer freedom and freedom to explain withholding, leaving the exclusion of an impersonal ground circular.
